title: My deadlines
subtitle: Your residence permit dates on one calm timeline: when to apply for an extension, and when permanent residence and citizenship come within reach.
privacy: Stored only in this browser. We never see these dates.

form.title: Your dates
form.hint: Fill in what you know. Every field is optional.
form.basis: What is your permit based on?
form.kindHint: It is printed on your residence permit card.
form.residenceStartHint: Usually the day you arrived, if your A permit was granted before you moved. Otherwise, the day your first permit was granted.
form.hasLanguage: I have a Finnish or Swedish language certificate at the level Migri asks for

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.empty: Add a date and your timeline appears here.
timeline.kindBNote: Time on a temporary (B) permit does not count towards permanent residence, and only half of it counts towards citizenship. Migri works these cases out individually.
timeline.cutByPermit: Your permit ends before the job search period does. If you have grounds for staying, apply for an extended permit before it ends.
timeline.calendarHint: Downloads a calendar file with reminders 3 months, 1 month and 1 week before each date. Your calendar app keeps them, not us.

extendOpens.title: You can apply for an extension
extendOpens.text: Migri assesses an extended permit from about {{months}} months before the current one ends. Apply online in Enter Finland.

permitEnds.title: Your permit ends
permitEnds.text: Apply for an extended permit by this day. While the application is being processed, you can keep living in Finland.

jobSearchEnds.title: Job search period ends
jobSearchEnds.text: With a work-based permit you have {{period}} months to find a new job or another basis for staying. After that, Migri may start withdrawing the permit.

permanentEarly.title: Earliest permanent residence
permanentEarly.text: After 4 years on a continuous permit, if you earn over €40,000 a year, or have 3 years of work history and good Finnish or Swedish.

permanent.title: Permanent residence
permanent.text: After 6 years on a continuous permit, with 2 years of work history in Finland and satisfactory Finnish or Swedish.

citizenship.title: Citizenship
citizenship.text: Usually after 8 years of residence, or 5 if you prove your language skills. Up to 365 days abroad count, at most 90 of them in the last year.
citizenship.text_language: After 5 years of residence with a language certificate. Up to 365 days abroad count, at most 90 of them in the last year.

job.title: If your job ends
job.hint: For work-based permits. A step-by-step plan for the months of job search. Nothing here has to happen today.
job.longProtection: I have a specialist permit, or I have lived in Finland on work-based permits for over two years (6 months instead of 3)
job.calm: Tick steps off as you go; they stay in this browser. If it gets heavy, write to someone in your network. Asking for help is normal here.

register.title: Register as a jobseeker.
register.text: Do it on your first day without work, in Job Market Finland. Benefits depend on it.

benefits.title: Apply for unemployment benefit.
benefits.text: From your unemployment fund if you are a member, otherwise from Kela.

checkPermit.title: Check when your permit ends.
checkPermit.text: The search period never lasts longer than the permit itself.
checkPermit.link: InfoFinland: can I lose my permit?

resume.title: Refresh your CV.
resume.text: One or two pages, in the Finnish format.

askNetwork.title: Ask three people for an introduction.
askNetwork.text: Not for a job, just for a talk with someone in your field.

shortage.title: Look at shortage sectors.
shortage.text: You can start a job in a sector on the government's shortage list without a new permit, while yours is valid.

companies.title: Look at companies where people like you work.
companies.text: Ask members there how they got in.

otherBasis.title: Look at other grounds for staying.
otherBasis.text: Studies, family ties or your own company each have a permit of their own.

advice.title: Get free advice.
advice.text: From your union's lawyer if you are a member, or from your city's international services.

newSector.title: New job in another sector?
newSector.text: If it is not a shortage sector and your permit was for a different one, apply for a new permit before you start.

applyInTime.title: Apply in time.
applyInTime.text: If you have another basis, submit the application before the search period or the permit ends.

disclaimer: This is not legal advice. Dates are approximate and follow Migri's rules as checked on {{date}}; your case may differ. Check the linked sources or ask Migri before you act.

promo.title: My deadlines
promo.text: Permit extension, permanent residence, citizenship: your dates on one timeline, stored only in your browser.
